title: State Library of Queensland
scope: Current South Bank library wing, its open-air Knowledge Walk, river decks and Red Box reading room, plus the mapped two-level Edge annex. Excludes the predecessor library in William Street, galleries next door, and unrepresented interior rooms and public artworks.
limitations: The current map fixes the site plan. Roof setbacks, blade rhythm, floor heights, terrace stairs, window details and exact finishes are architectural estimates.
The unchanged Queensland Government elevation raster establishes site grade. Discrete floor and threshold elevations are approximate.
The sole CC0 image in the published Qualla set shows an indoor workshop. The standing exterior was built from written architectural facts and native geometry with no adopted reference imagery.
